title: Gaza strike kills two Doctors Without Borders (MSF) staff; Israel links them to Hamas
detail: France 24 reports on Nov 28 that a strike in Gaza killed two staff members of Doctors Without Borders (MSF), and that Israel links them to Hamas. Only the headline was available at the time of writing; the strike location, the victims' identities and MSF's response remain unconfirmed, and Israel's claim is unverified.
confidenceReason: Single headline-level report; Israeli claim of Hamas links not independently verified.
